searchText: We did an EIP7702 whiteboarding session at ETHCC, and want to get additional feedback on some changes to the spec. Writeup: https://hackmd.io/@S9AwbucvTS6GYodLz-G1SQ/S102UtTwA The proposal, reduces work required to manage DOS, enables new use-cases and supports ephemeral SCAs. as mentioned in <#718596092828057631>, this proposal just reintroduces the issues we had with EOA migration (namely how to deal with ERCs like permit) and therefore I don't think it is a good direction **ACDE tomorrow 14:00 UTC** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1098 Stream: https://www.youtube.com/live/kL58hvM0E68 Will post the zoom link here before the call.

excerpts.content:
We did an EIP7702 whiteboarding session at ETHCC, and want to get additional feedback on some changes to the spec.
Writeup: https://hackmd.io/@S9AwbucvTS6GYodLz-G1SQ/S102UtTwA

The proposal, reduces work required to manage DOS, enables new use-cases and supports ephemeral SCAs.

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: as mentioned in <#718596092828057631>, this proposal just reintroduces the issues we had with EOA migration (namely how to deal with ERCs like permit) and therefore I don't think it is a good direction
